reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per country and month with signups
  SELECT country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT country_code, month, signups,
  SUM(signups) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_signups
FROM monthly

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per country and month with signups
  SELECT country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.country_code, m.month, m.signups,
  (SELECT SUM(m2.signups) FROM monthly m2 WHERE m2.country_code = m.country_code AND m2.month <= m.month) AS cumulative_signups
FROM monthly m

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per country and month with signups
  SELECT country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY country_code, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.country_code, m.month, m.signups, SUM(e.signups) AS cumulative_signups
FROM monthly m
JOIN monthly e ON e.country_code = m.country_code AND e.month <= m.month
GROUP BY m.country_code, m.month, m.signups
